items.title: Tools API
items.body: {{counts.tool_count}} tools for chess, hex maps, piece gallery, rules queries, RPG oracles (10 systems), entity browser, encounter building, classic game engines, and utilities. Connect in one command via MCP or call via REST.

items.title: Build Examples
items.body: Telegram chess coaches, Discord map bots, Slack puzzle-of-the-day, AI game assistants, and procedural world builders.

items.title: Live Server
items.body: The MCP server running at tools.moddable.games. Interactive docs, OpenAPI spec, llms.txt discovery, and a live tool explorer.

sections.cta_heading: The only board game MCP server
sections.cta_body: Zero other chess tools support variant analysis via AI. No hex map generator exists as a callable tool. Connect once, access everything.
